BEYOND THE WORK

A little more about me.

I’m Salwa, a UX Design and Content Creation student in Berlin. I’m drawn to both sides of design — how something works and how it makes you feel.

I enjoy taking an idea, asking lots of questions, and slowly shaping the details until everything comes together. I like exploring different sides of design, from UX/UI to visual design, and learning something new with every project.
